description: This file defines the ProductDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for Product entities. It declares methods for retrieving products based on various criteria such as locale, categories, store, tax class, and URL.

classes.name: ProductDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Product entities, providing methods to fetch products by various criteria.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product for a specific product ID, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products for a store, filtered by category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products belonging to specified categories.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of products available in a store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves products in categories filtered by language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a product based on store, SEO URL, and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its code and language.
